description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lg (General, LANGID 0x0409) read-only. On the indexed T and the unindexed T0, reads the ID sequence of ORDER BY K, K DESC, K then ID, K DESC then ID DESC, and K DESC then ID; the (K, COUNT, MIN ID, MAX ID) of GROUP BY K ORDER BY K; SELECT DISTINCT K ORDER BY K; and SELECT TOP 5 ID with ORDER BY K and with ORDER BY K DESC. Asks the public order and tie order with and without an index, which spelling represents a group, and how TOP treats ties at its boundary.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
